question: Can I tap more creatures than necessary to pay a crew cost?

expected.shortAnswer: Yes: you may tap more creatures than necessary to activate a crew ability.
expected.answer: You may tap more creatures than necessary to activate a crew ability.

whyHard: Costs usually require exactly what they name, so players think crew can only be paid with the minimum.
